sourceProjection.basis: The Premio Architettura Toscana 2024 catalogue page places three separately labelled floor plans in parallel. Each has parallel outer walls and a consistent top-down auditorium footprint; adjacent sections and elevations are not extracted.

review: Premio Architettura Toscana 2024 official award catalogue, PDF page 50 (printed spread 96-97), project by Studio Benaim. The three embedded images labelled piano terra, piano primo and piano secondo were inspected individually. Their walls, stage/screen end, seating tiers, bookcase/furnishing layout and stair footprints are retained. The source prints no room numbers. Physical stair cores are linked across levels, but that does not claim public access on a particular day.
limitations: 获奖项目图记录建筑改造结果，不代表实时开放限制或活动布置。
图源未印展厅编号；地点只使用描述性建筑名称。
导览停点3绑定于底层可见的观众厅装饰区，不把未标名且开放状态不确定的一层镜厅写成已确认空间。
